description: This file provides expense management functions for a frontend application, including listing, creating, updating, deleting expenses, and calculating expense summaries, all interfacing with a Supabase backend.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Builds a concise error message from Supabase error objects.

methods.name: normalizeExpense
methods.description: Normalizes and validates an expense payload before sending to Supabase.

methods.name: stripId
methods.description: Removes 'id' from objects to prevent client-supplied IDs from being sent to the backend.

methods.name: listExpenses
methods.description: Fetches a list of expenses for a user within optional date and category filters.

methods.name: createExpense
methods.description: Creates a new expense record in the database, removing any client-supplied ID.

methods.name: createExpenseSafe
methods.description: Creates a new expense with schema validation and ID stripping.

methods.name: updateExpense
methods.description: Updates an existing expense record identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteExpense
methods.description: Deletes an expense record by ID.

methods.name: sumExpensesByCategory
methods.description: Calculates total expenses grouped by category for a user in a specific month.

methods.name: totalSpentInMonth
methods.description: Calculates total amount spent by a user in a specific month.
